name: Jugendzeltplatz des Kreisjugendring Weilheim-Schongau
beschreibung: The youth campsite of the Kreisjugendring Weilheim-Schongau is located in a rural region in Tirol. The atmosphere is close to nature and geared toward youth groups and clubs. The surroundings offer mountains, forests, and access to ski areas as well as hiking trails for various activities. The facilities include a campsite with simple sanitary facilities and a common room. Guests must bring their own tents and food; there are no dining facilities. The site is open seasonally and requires advance registration. It is particularly suitable for school residential stays and youth leisure camps. The capacity is designed for medium-sized groups.
